title: 3 Easy Ways To Be Effortlessly Hilarious
speaker: Charisma on Command
zh: 【Charisma on Command】輕鬆搞笑的 3 種簡單方法（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: Louis C.K. is one of the most respected comedians in the world

cues.en: and part of it is because he seemed so effortlessly funny.

cues.text: There's no big action like with Jim Carrey or Robin Williams — no elaborately clever setups — just simple truths that make audiences crack up.
